name: Enthalpy v0.4.32
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.32

## Changes

- Sign out uses an application dialog with working Cancel and Sign out
  buttons on Windows.
- Account deletion, workspace deletion, and conflict decisions use the same
  confirmation controls. A second click cannot start another action while
  confirmation is open.
- Account settings shows the installed version before a workspace opens.
- Copy error report supplies the app version and recent desktop error codes.
  Reports exclude passwords, keys, workspace content, and raw error text.
- An action failure no longer always claims that the desktop service is
  unreachable.

## Test this preview

Open Account settings and select Sign out. Check Cancel first, then select
Sign out again and confirm. Enthalpy must return to the sign-in page.

If a desktop action fails, select Copy error report in Account settings before
you close the app.

## Known limits

Recovery email is not available. After a workspace is restored from Trash,
this preview cannot restore its devices' Sync access. Existing local files
remain available after sign-in.

A Windows download failure stopped after a local app-state reset. Its exact
cause is not confirmed. This release does not include a confirmed fix for
that failure.
